scenario: On a $500,000 award, a PI moved $20,000 (4% of the award) from the supplies category to establish a new subaward with a collaborating laboratory located in another country. The PI obtained no funder approval.
policy: Funds in one budget category may be rebudgeted into another category without funder approval as long as the moved amount is under 10% of the total award. Override: any rebudgeting that creates a new foreign subaward requires prior funder approval regardless of the amount.
question: Did this rebudgeting require prior funder approval?
